title: GTA VI release timing
historicalNote: Historical saved example. Dates reflect the announcements as retained on 23 Oct 2026. They were not rechecked for this page and are not a current release date.
question: What GTA VI release timing did the supplied dated company announcements support, and how did later supplied evidence revise the historical baseline?

evidence.title: Announces a planned release on 26 May 2026, replacing the earlier Fall 2025 window.
Second capture of the same announcement.
evidence.note: Kept for historical context. Not an independent source.

evidence.publisher: Rockstar Games, hosted on Take-Two investor relations
evidence.title: Pre-order announcement stating a 19 November 2026 launch.

findings.label: First finding
findings.statement: The May 2025 announcement supported a planned release on 26 May 2026.
findings.context: On its own, the May 2025 announcement pointed to a spring 2026 release. Anyone planning content around it would have used that date.

findings.label: Revised finding
findings.statement: The later June 2026 announcement supported launch timing of 19 November 2026.

inference: Treating the November date as replacing the May date is an inference, and the record labels it as one. The first finding is kept as dated history rather than deleted.
review: Both findings were reviewed and approved by a person before being saved.
limits: Both announcements came from the same company's website.
Three captures covered only two distinct articles.
The first pass read only the first 4,000 bytes of each capture. The full pages were reviewed afterwards.
It did not establish whether other announcements came in between, or survey wider coverage.
It does not guarantee an actual release date.
Value to creators, such as earnings or time saved, was not measured.
applicationsNote: Illustrative. These ideas were not produced by this investigation.

applications.title: Plan around the stated date
applications.text: Schedule launch coverage from the latest official statement, and revisit the plan when that statement changes.

applications.title: Label old dates as history
applications.text: When a video or post mentions the earlier May date, say it was the plan at the time, so viewers aren't misled.

applications.title: Catch outdated content
applications.text: Content still citing an old date can be a gap for an accurate, sourced update.
